Daily Quiz.question: ১) Billal is the best boy in the class. (Comparative)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Very few boys in the class are as good as Billal.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Billal is a good boy in the class.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Billal is better than any other boy in the class.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Billal is better than any other boys in the class.
Daily Quiz.exp: Sub + be verb + comparative form + than any other + বাকি অংশ।

Daily Quiz.question:
২) Select the right compound structure of the sentence :
'Though he is poor, he is honest'
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He is poor and honest
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) As he is poor and honest
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) As he is poor, he is honest
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He is poor but honest
Daily Quiz.exp: পরস্পর বিপরীত ভাব প্রকাশক দুইটি clause থাকলে compound sentence এ এগুলো but দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়। তাই সঠিক উত্তর হবে He is poor but honest.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Identify the correct passive form of the sentence. ‘Do you see the flower?’
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Is the flower seen by you
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Is the flower was seen by you?
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Is the flower being seen by you?
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Is the flower seen by you?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Am/is/are + obj কে sub + verb এর P.P + by + sub কে obj + question mark.
অপশন ’ক’ তে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন নাই, তাই উত্তর অপশন ‘ঘ’।

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) These essays are intellectually ________ and represent various levels of complexity.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) revealing
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) modern
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) superior
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) demanding
Daily Quiz.exp: Superior অর্থ অন্যদের থেকে ভালো। Essay গুলো intellectually অন্যদের থেকে ভালো।

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) ‘I know what his name is’ is a ______ sentence.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) compound
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) complex
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) simple
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) exclamatory
Daily Quiz.exp: Complex sentence এ who, which, that, what ইত্যাদি relative pronoun দ্বারা দুটি clause যুক্ত থাকে। প্রদত্ত বাক্যে I know এবং his name is হলো দুটি clause যা what দ্বারা যুক্ত রয়েছে। তাই complex sentence .

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) The Passive from of the sentence .'We made her recite a poem'-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) a poem was made recite by her
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) she was made to recite a poem
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) she was made recited a poem
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) a poem was made to be recited
Daily Quiz.exp: Make, help, see ইত্যাদি verb সমূহের ক্ষেত্রে Active Voice এ এদের পরে Infinitive ‘to’ বসে না। কিন্তু Passive এ রূপান্তর করতে গেলে বাক্যের পরের verb টির পূর্বে ‘to’ infinitive বসাতে হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) ‘Jumping up he ran away.’ This sentence is-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) simple
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) compound
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) complex
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) gerund
Daily Quiz.exp: একটি মাত্র subject এবং একটি মাত্র finite verb নিয়ে simple sentence গঠিত হয়। প্রদত্ত বাক্যে he হলো বাক্যের subject এবং ran away হলো finite verb.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Computer _________ all over the world at the moment.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) is using
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) has used
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) has been using
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) is being used
Daily Quiz.exp: যেহেতু বাক্যটি Passive voice এ লেখা, তাই অপশন ‘ঘ’ is being used সঠিক উত্তর।

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Choose the simple sentence of ‘Munni is a girl who is good.’
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Munni is being a good girl.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Munni is not an ugly girl.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Munni has been a good girl.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Munni is a good girl.
Daily Quiz.exp: Relative pronoun এর পর be verb + adjective থাকলে simple করার জন্য adjective টি relative pronoun এর ঠিক পূর্বের noun এর পূর্বে বসাতে হবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Whom did she accuse? (Passive voice)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Who had been accused by her?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Who was accused by her?
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Who was being accused by her?
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) By whom was she accused?

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) He acted on my advice. (Complex)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I advised him and he acted.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I advised him that he acted.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He acted according to my advice.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He acted as I advised him.

Simple sentence: He acted on my advice.
Complex sentence: He acted as I advised him.
Complex sentence এর গঠন অনুসারে “He acted as I advised him.” সঠিক উত্তর।

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Select the correct passive voice of ‘I knew him’.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He is known to me.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He is known by me.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He was known to me.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He was known by me.
Daily Quiz.exp: Passive voice এ know এর পরে by না বসে to বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) I know him better than you. (Positive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) You do not know him as good as I know.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) You do not know him as well as I know.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) You do not know him as well as me.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) You do not know him as good as me.
Daily Quiz.exp: Good/well এর comparative এবং superlative degree যথাক্রমে better/best. বাক্যের গঠন এবং যথাযথ অর্থবিচারে “You do not know him as well as I know” সঠিক উত্তর।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Give the order. (Passive voice)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Let the order to give
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Let the order to given
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Let the order be given
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Let the order give
Daily Quiz.exp: An imperative sentence in the passive voice has the following form: Let + object + be + past participle.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) 'I heard that she was singing.' (Simple)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) I heard her singing.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) I heard her to sing.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) I heard her being singing.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) I heard her song.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the given sentence: ''We were no more surprised than Rahman''.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) We were as surprised as Rahim.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) We were all surprised.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Rahman was less surprised than us.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) We were as surprised as Rahman.
Daily Quiz.exp: We were no more surprised than Rahman. অর্থ-আমরা রহমানের চেয়ে বেশি বিস্মিত ছিলো না। এর মানে হলো, আমরা রহমানের মত বিস্মিত ছিলাম- We were as surprised as Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question:
১৭) Complete the sentence by choosing the clause that makes it compound.
He has a good job, ______________ .
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) as he works hard
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) yet he never seems to have any money
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) though he is unhappy
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) since he is very competent
Daily Quiz.exp: প্রদত্ত clause এর পর কমা থাকায় as, though এবং since দ্বারা compound sentence গঠন করা যাবে না। শুধু yet দ্বারা সম্ভব।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) He is as intimate to me as to you. (Comparative)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He is not more intimate to you than to me.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He is not more intimate to you than to us.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He is same intimate to you as well as to me also.
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He is not more intimate to you than for us.
Daily Quiz.exp: Positive degree তে as ……. as থাকলে comparative এ তা not + comparative form ব্যবহৃত হয়। আর এখানে to you than to me হবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) You must work hard for success. (Compound)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Work hard and you will succeed
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Work hard for success
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) Work hard to success
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Work hard for the success
Daily Quiz.exp: Compound sentence এ সাধারণত দুইটি principal clause and, or, but, else, yet, otherwise, therefore ইত্যাদি conjunction দ্বারা যুক্ত থাকে।

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) The Padma is one of the biggest rivers in Bangladesh. (Positive)
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) Very few river in Bangladesh is as big as the Padma.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Very few rivers in Bangladesh are as big as the Padma.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) No other river in Bangladesh is as big as the Padma.

Superlative degree তে one of the থাকলে Positive degree তে very few হয়।
Very few + plural noun + plural verb + as + positive degree + as + subject.
